title: Black Wall Street, Ep. 2 — One Shot
evidence_boundary: Survivor-memory retelling of the documented 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre. Narrator and family are fictional; surrounding events follow the record. Hedged names and dates are deliberate memory texture, not errors.
desired_movement: Campfire testimony: a 106-year-old reaching back, nicknames outliving names, sensation outliving statistics.
grounding: Her porch, the fire, the brass elevator box, the tracks, the whistle before sunup.
invitation: Ten parts, one story, told to you by the fire.
era_style: 1921 memory, black and white with hand-tinted moments
